title: Corrupt generated ledger metadata can dead-end sync refresh
description: Evidence: sync refresh first calls rebuildProjectionsRespectingTombstones, which parses existing generated ledger manifest/deletions through readGeneratedLedgerTombstones; that path only ignores ENOENT. Impact: sync status can recommend sync refresh for invalid ledgers, but refresh can fail before regenerating the ledgers.
acceptanceCriteria: Corrupt generated ledger manifest/deletions fail open for tombstone discovery or produce a specific recoverable status.
A regression proves sync refresh can regenerate ledgers from runtime state after generated ledger metadata is malformed.
